title: scriptc native executor
description: Compile each package bin from the package's transformed JavaScript to one platform's executable with scriptc and zig

cwd.description: Project root, relative to the workspace root

tsConfig.description: The package's emit config, relative to cwd, which the run emits with ttsc into private staging

triple.description: The triple SCRIPTC_TARGET names, e.g. aarch64-linux-musl

outputDirectory.description: Directory receiving the executables, e.g. dist/bin/linux-arm64, relative to cwd

entries.description: Executable name to its entry module, relative to the emitted JavaScript's root
